description:
Flashing lights, adoring fans screaming your name, the exhilaration of being on stage… 

Gyeol-Namu, also known as Gyeo-Wool, knows that he was born to be a star. And he’s more determined than anyone to follow the path that was destined for him. But regardless of all of Gyeo-wool’s efforts, the enormous amount of pressure he puts on himself as the leader of his new idol group, “Pale Green,” causes him to spend his days wallowing in anxiety and self-doubt. That is, until one day, Gyeo-Wool discovers a gentle hand repeatedly helping him from the shadows. A hand that belongs to “Gyeol,” an experienced idol belonging to the massively popular group, “Kimberly.” Although Gyeo-Wool is grateful for his reliable and handsome sunbae, he can’t help but wonder… Why is Gyeol treating him like he’s special? 

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes four extra chapters.*
